Collecting Elemental Pickups or destroying a <strand/>Tangle grants additional Transcendence Energy of the matching alignment:
• <arc/>Ionic Traces, <solar/>Firesprites, <void/>Void Breaches: 7.5% Light Transcendence Energy 
• <stasis/>Stasis Shards: 5% Darkness Transcendence Energy
• <strand/>Tangles: 10% Darkness Transcendence Energy
